newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel sees stiff resistance at 130.62.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel sees stiff resistance at 130.62.

text.p: September notionnel futures on MATIF pushed higher on Friday, but were likely to hesitate at stiff resistance around 130.62, analysts said.
"We'll be happy to push through resistance at 130.22, but likely to find the 130.62 level harder," said Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London.
By 0838 GMT, September notionnel were up 0.18 at 130.06.
Whitby pegged support at Thursday's high of 129.94/92, but said a fall below Thursday's low of 129.80 would see stronger selling pressure emerge.

Whitby said the September contract could ease back to 129.94/92 level without doing too much overall damage, but said an overbought RSI made gains above the June 13 continuation chart high of 130.62 tricky.
Ian Stannard, technical strategist at Chase in London, said any corrective pullback would find support at 129.66 and 129.52.
But he cautioned in a research note that any dip below those levels could spark a downward correction.
"Failure to hold up above here would leave notionnel vulnerable to a correction targeting up trendline support at 129.27," Stannard said.
A technical analyst at a European bank in London said a break below 129.50 would increase short-term downside risk.
The relative strength index showed a notionnel reading of 73.48. A reading over 70 percent indicates an overbought contract.
September Pibor futures were unchanged on the day at 96.57.
